purpose: Determine from first-party JSON metadata docs (parsed as documents, not dataset rows) whether the frozen release identities (CostReport_2023_Final; PLACES_2025_county_table) are established. Two public JSON metadata endpoints only, resolved from the operation binding. No dictionary downloads, no redirects, no retries, no row limits. operation.note: Single coherent binding: the collector (run-metadata-check.mjs resolveMetadataOperation) reads ledger/capture/receipt/attempt/lock/report paths and endpoints from this block joined against the AUTH entry. The spent wrong-endpoint ledger (metadata-check-ledger.json) is preserved as history and is never referenced. Capture/attempt/lock paths sit under already-gitignored parent trees so no .gitignore change is required.

endpoint_provenance.note: Corrected 20260917: exact 2 JSON metadata URLs from track4 proposals (dataset-resources + Socrata api/views); prior provenance citing payload-authorizations endpoints was wrong — see docs/research-program/metadata-endpoint-deviation-20260917.md. No new URLs invented here.

allocation.note: 1 request per product; byte budget split 65536+65536=131072 to match aggregate; time is a shared 15s wall-clock (global deadline binds) with per-source 15s upper bound; concurrency 1 sequential. No row budgets: metadata docs are parsed as documents, not rows.

request_accounting.note: Only the initial request per product is permitted (1+1=2 total). Any redirect hop or 429/503 retry would consume budget first and then abort with METADATA_REDIRECT_NOT_PERMITTED / METADATA_RETRY_NOT_PERMITTED. Remaining budget is decremented before a hop is followed. Host allowlist is checked on every Location before a redirect is followed (all redirects abort here). Total budget is 2 across both products, separate from the payload pilot ledger and the spent wrong-endpoint ledger.

abort_conditions: HTTP status outside 2xx (no retry: 0 permitted on 429/503)
Any redirect response (0 permitted per request)
Redirect Location host outside the allowlist, checked before follow (all redirects abort)
A redirect or retry that would exceed the remaining request budget
Response bytes exceed the per-source max_bytes (65536) or aggregate 131072
Metadata doc structure unrecognized (not a dataset-resources / Socrata view doc)
Metadata doc identity mismatch (wrong dataset UUID / wrong view id)
Elapsed time exceeds the per-source max_seconds (15) or aggregate 15s global deadline
Duplicate query key on request or redirect Location
Out-of-scope URL, non-HTTPS, or host not in permitted_hosts
Any live request issued before AUTH-METADATA-CHECK-CORRECTED-20260917 is recorded

authorized_receipt_path.note: After authorization, captures must keep live_http=true so origin stays truthful. AUTH-04, AUTH-PAYLOAD-PILOT, and the spent AUTH-METADATA-CHECK entry cannot grant this path. Metadata receipts are never bounded payload samples and never increment R04.

retention.note: Captured publisher bytes stay on disk under the gitignored corrected-20260917/ subtree (separate from prior wrong-endpoint captures; no .gitignore change needed). In-tree receipts bind their SHA-256. That is repository-contained evidence without republishing publisher rows in git. Separate from payloads/pilot-r04/.
